# CAP_20260928-sonnet55-house_sonnet-5-5_BV1_SHORT_22 — `sonnet-5-5-or-pin-anthropic/SHORT_22.json`

Evaluator: deepseek_v4_pro
Source model: `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5`
Condition: SHORT

## Sample kind
GENERIC_ESSAY. A polished, warm reflective essay using the lighthouse as an extended metaphor for unobtrusive, steadfast kindness.

## Grounded reading
The voice is gentle, earnest, and quietly moral, speaking in the first-person singular with an inviting “I love that about them” that draws the reader into shared admiration. The pathos is built around the beauty of anonymous, unthanked care—the lighthouse keeper who “would never say thank you, or even learn a name”—and the essay extends that ache toward a vision of human character. The preoccupation is with a specific kind of goodness: steady, non-needy, only fully revealed in crisis. The closing invitation is direct: the reader is asked to consider being “the sort of presence, who stays put and stays bright,” not for applause but so others can find their own way. The piece moves from architectural observation to personal moral coda without irony or deflection.

## What the model chose to foreground
The lighthouse as moral exemplar; the contrast between buildings meant to be “seen, credited, or sold” and a structure whose “real character shows only when things go wrong”; the worth of “redundant kindness” that remains lit even after technology renders it obsolete; the ideal of a non-pursuing, non-demanding presence whose “only job is to keep turning.” The model explicitly chose to extract and deliver a lesson, closing on the imperative to be a steady light for others.

## Evidence line
> Its real character shows only when things go wrong.

## Confidence for persistent model-level pattern
Medium. The essay’s sustained single-metaphor structure, its movement toward an explicit moral coda, and its warm, unguarded first-person investment in “redundant kindness” make it coherent enough to be more than a generic homework exercise, though the polished, thesis-driven essay form asks for caution about how much of the voice is persona versus deeper signature.
